metadata.note: A declared pacman GROUP (`fprint` = fprintd + libfprint), which plan() and import_state() must understand: a group name is never an installed package, so before group support the plan said `+ install fprint` forever and the first sync rewrote it into its members. `fprint` is used because it is two small packages from extra — the behaviour under test is the group indirection, not the payload. For the QEMU VM harness (scripts/vmtest/qemu.sh install-driven, then drive guest-pacman-group.sh GROUP-DONE). Targets the guest's /dev/vda. NOT for real hardware. Autologins root on ttyS0 and ships python-pydantic/python-colorama via pacman, so the driver gets a shell and dasik runs from the 9p-mounted repo with no network.
